access: The Spark UI or History Server for the run being tuned (event logs enabled for a finished run)
Permission to re-run the job on the same input to measure the fix

presentation.name: Tune a slow Spark job from its Spark UI evidence
presentation.summary: Finds the stage and the cause that dominate a slow or memory-failing Spark job, fixes that cause and measures the result.
benefits: Reads task-duration spread, shuffle and spill to tell skew, a missed broadcast and a fanning-out join apart
Explains why each fix works: broadcast joins, AQE, salting, partition sizing, repartition versus coalesce
Catches driver-side work and Python UDFs that no cluster setting can speed up
Confirms the gain by re-running on the same input and checking the output did not change
